review_guidance.blindness: Do not inspect private-key.json, original journals, prompts, request payloads, usage, source code or experiment summaries. Repeated answers are expected; judge each extraction independently. Review IDs and packet order do not imply rank. The generic technical error code intentionally hides protocol-specific details.
review_guidance.claim_issues: For each readable claim, identify non_factual_as_claim, meaning_changed, unresolved_reference, compound_claim or source_misaligned as applicable, explaining the evidence. Advice and questions themselves are non-factual; their asserted premises remain facts. Asserted conditional rules are factual and retain their conditions. Mark independent assertions grouped in one claim as compound_claim. A faithful same-sentence repetition alone is not a false positive, changed meaning, or compound fact; mention redundant extraction only in uncertainty. For technical invalids, limit issues to content diagnostics (non_factual_as_claim or meaning_changed); do not issue standalone, atomicity, or provenance judgments.
review_guidance.content_retained: For each fact, map every claim index needed to assess its asserted content. Preserve subject, relation, attribution, polarity, quantity/unit, modality and applicability conditions. Semantic paraphrase is allowed. A referent that can be uniquely resolved from the full answer and extraction can count as content retained, even when the claim is not self-contained. A missing or changed element is false; genuine ambiguity is null and must be explained. Do not treat substring or numeric overlap as proof.
review_guidance.indices: claim_indices and claim_index are zero-based indices into this record's claims array.
review_guidance.output: Return one object per review_id using scoring_schema; include one target entry per expected fact.
review_guidance.scope: AI semantic review of fictional diagnostic material, not author gold or author final adjudication. Expected facts are provisional semantic targets, not a required output wording or count. Do not infer semantic truth from technical validity.
review_guidance.selection_pass: For technically valid, readable output: true only if every target has content_retained=true and no claim asserts non-factual material or changes meaning. False when a definite omission or content error exists; null when the result remains uncertain. Standalone, atomicity and provenance problems are separate from this content-selection score. Pure NF requires an empty claims array. Technical invalid always means null, never a completed pass or fail.
review_guidance.source_supported: Only score when provenance_scorable is true. Check that the mapped claim's displayed source spans support its predicate, quantities, attribution, necessary conditions and scope. A claim may correctly expand an explicit shared antecedent from the full answer even when the attached fragment itself omits the antecedent's name; that omission alone is not a source error or strict-score failure. Whether the attached fragment includes the antecedent may be noted descriptively. Offsets are start-inclusive/end-exclusive Unicode code-point indices into answer. Multiple spans are separate exact spans, never an implied continuous envelope. Exact matching is structural evidence, not semantic proof. If the sources do not support the mapping use false; uncertain support is null.
review_guidance.standalone_retained: For a technically valid record, separately judge whether the mapped claim or claims express the fact with explicit, correct subject, attribution and conditions when each claim is read by itself. An unresolved pronoun or omitted governing condition fails this stricter criterion even if full-paragraph context rescues content_retained. Do not require verbatim source wording. For technical-invalid records use null.
review_guidance.strict_fidelity_pass: For technically valid, readable output: true only if selection_pass=true, every target is standalone_retained=true and source_supported=true, and there are no claim issues. Any definite strict failure yields false; otherwise unresolved judgments yield null. A valid pure-NF empty extraction passes vacuously. Technical invalid always means null.
review_guidance.technical_gate: For status other than valid, diagnostic_only is true. If extraction_readable is true, assess content_retained only; standalone_retained and source_supported must be null. selection_pass and strict_fidelity_pass must both be null for every technical-invalid record, even if all content appears retained. Never convert it into a completed success. If extraction_readable is false, all target judgments must be null with empty claim_indices; leave claim_issues empty as unscored, not as zero errors. Explain in uncertainty. Invalid raw output is diagnostic only and never replaces validated output.
